name: Harbour Lights
summary: Harbour Lights is a beach club on Carlisle Bay with loungers, umbrellas, a bar and grill, showers and changing rooms. Its tour boat, Koopa Troopa, runs short snorkel trips from the beach to a shipwreck in Carlisle Bay Marine Park and to see hawksbill and green turtles. Snorkel tours can be booked alone or with a lounger and lunch.
standouts: Snorkel tours leave from the beach on Carlisle Bay
Four possible wreck sites, chosen to suit the swimmers
Life vest, snorkel and mask included
Showers, changing rooms and free WiFi at the beach club

contact.address: Marine Villa, Bay Street, St Michael, Barbados

trips.title: Sea Turtle + Shipwreck Snorkel Tour
trips.summary: A short guided snorkel by boat from the Harbour Lights beach to one of the wrecks in Carlisle Bay Marine Park, then on to see hawksbill and green turtles. The wreck is chosen to suit how confident the group is in the water, and you are brought back to the beach afterwards.
highlights: Tours at 10:30am, 11:30am and 12:30pm; other times on request
One of four wrecks: Berwyn, C-Trek, Bajan Queen or Eillon
Life vest, snorkel and mask included
trips.duration: Approx. 45 minutes (45 to 60 minutes on the tour page)

trips.checkNotes: Price conflict: the tour card and the checkout page show $25.00 USD per person, but the description on the same pages (and on /day) says 'for just $35USD per person'; used $25. The booking page says prices change for visits from 2 November 2026. Duration is 'Approx. 45 Minute' on the booking page and '45-60 minutes' on the tour page. The FAQ lists a USD 12.50 per person beach club cover charge; it is not clear whether a tour-only ticket also needs it. No turtle feeding advertised.

trips.summary: A day on the Harbour Lights beach with your own lounger and a shared umbrella, plus the guided snorkel tour to the wrecks and turtles of Carlisle Bay. Front-row and second-row loungers can be guaranteed for a higher price.
highlights: Personal lounger and shared umbrella for the day
Guided snorkel tour of the shipwrecks and turtles
Snorkel tour times run from 10:30am to 1:30pm
Guaranteed front-row or second-row seating available

checkNotes: Harbour Lights is mainly a beach club, dinner show (Wednesday and Thursday) and Friday nightclub; only the snorkel tour and the beach packages that include it are recorded as trips, and the dinner show and nightclub are left out as non-marine. Booking is online through the operator's own checkout (Drupal Ubercart pages with HubSpot forms). The site states all prices are in USD and gives $1 USD = $1.98 BBD. Marketplace listings (TripAdvisor) linked from the site were not used. The beach club page mentions cruise passengers can take a taxi from the port for about USD 5.
